'''2009 US West Nationals Day 1 Mike French LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mike French]] at [[2009 US West Nationals]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Default
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
